answer: An agent market for lagoon tours, jetty repairs, and mesa surveys requires every seller identity to lock 100 tokens in escrow while taking orders and for 30 days after its last order. Creating names is free, but activating 1,000 sellers ties up 100,000 tokens. The bond makes influence depend on committed capital rather than account count, so an attacker must finance each fake seller and bear the cost of keeping that capital unavailable.
